name: Inaba Ayumi
source:
School: 2nd year, Chabatake Gakuen School
Description: sophisticated
Profile: She is the founder of a band.  She sees joining the club as an opportunity to recruit members.  She is regarded as strange by people around her in a good way because she's unique in fashion and her ways of thinking. She 
thinks individuality is important and both partners need to respect each other in a relationship.
